name: What preparation is needed before a drywall restoration team starts work?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before a drywall restoration team starts work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the crew arrives, clear furniture, wall decor, and personal belongings at least four to six feet away from the work zone. Drywall cutting and sanding generate fine dust, so establishing a clear perimeter helps crews mask off the space efficiently with plastic sheeting and floor paper. If the damage was caused by a water leak, make sure the plumbing or roofing leak is fully repaired and that moisture levels have returned to normal. Providing HH Remodeling with any leftover wall paint or trim paint codes also speeds up the final paint touchup stage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear furniture and decor from the area, confirm that any water leaks are fixed and dry, and locate existing wall paint codes to streamline final finishing.
